attchmntText: Rajesh Exports Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rajesh Exports Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. Net sales were Rs. 485.38 million. Net profit after tax was Rs. 101.27 million. Earnings per share was Rs. 0.34. Total assets stood at Rs. 7,069.65 million. Equity was Rs. 5,115.53 million. Borrowings were Rs. 4,780.57 million. Cash and cash equivalents were Rs. 3,811.02 million. The auditor issued a clean review report with no modified opinion. The company deals in gold products. Results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.
